manifest.scheduling: Sequential action groups; ten separate PostgreSQL sessions submitted concurrently within each group
manifest.endpoint: transition_coach_proposal via direct authenticated-role SQL; excludes HTTP, model and UI latency

environment.postgres: PostgreSQL 17.6 on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (GCC) 15.2.0, 64-bit

latencyMs.scope: All primary submissions, including failed responses; excludes setup, inspection and separate fault probes

checks.name: same ID with conflicting contents admits only the winning payload
discarded post-commit response retries without duplication
business insert failure rolls back receipt and proposal transition
cross-account reads and confirmations are denied
